hero.title: Urubuga rw'ubucuruzi no kwamamaza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga
hero.subtitle: Mu Rwanda, Africa no kw'Isi hose
hero.description: Kumenyekanisha ibikorwa byawe cyangwa ikigo cyanyu twifashije ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, bigafasha kugera kuri benshi mu gihe gito, ibikorwa byawe cyangwa by'ikigo cyanyu bikaguka cyane.

about.title: Urubuga rw'ubucuruzi no kwamamaza hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga
about.description: Amamazanonaha Ltd ni urubuga rw'ubucuruzi no kwamamaza rwitegereza ejo hazaza, rugamije guhuza abantu, ubucuruzi, ibicuruzwa, serivisi n'amahirwe, byose ahantu hamwe horoshye kugerwaho.
about.subDescription: Tunyuze mu guhanga udushya no mu bunyamwuga, dufasha ubucuruzi kurushaho kumenyekana, guhangana ku isoko no kugera ku mahirwe yo gukura.

vision.title: ICYEREKEZO
vision.text: Kuba urubuga ruyoboye mu bucuruzi bwifashisha ikoranabuhanga no mu iterambere ry'ubucuruzi, ruhuza u Rwanda na Afurika n'isi yose.

mission.title: INSHINGANO
mission.text: Guha imbaraga ubucuruzi, ba rwiyemezamirimo n'abaturage, tubaha ibisubizo by'isoko ry'ikoranabuhanga byoroshye kugerwaho.

services.title: Serivisi zacu
services.description: Urubuga rwuzuye ruguhuza n'ibyo ukeneye byose — byose byemejwe, bifite umutekano kandi byoroshye kubona.

marketplace.title: Kwinjira ku isoko rya interineti
marketplace.desc: Ahantu h'umwuga abakiriya bavumburira ibicuruzwa na serivisi mu buryo bworoshye.

ecommerce.title: Ibisubizo by'ubucuruzi kuri interineti
ecommerce.desc: Duha ubucuruzi ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga byo kugurisha, kwamamaza no kwagura ibikorwa kuri interineti.

marketing.title: Kwamamaza no kumenyekanisha ikirango
marketing.desc: Ingamba zo kongera kumenyekanisha ikirango zifasha gukurura abaguzi nyabo no kongera kugaragara ku isoko.

promotion.title: Kumenyekanisha ubucuruzi
promotion.desc: Kwamamaza kwibanda ku bakiriya bakwiye, kugira ngo wongere umubare w'abaguzi bawe.

discovery.title: Kuvumbura no Kumenya Amahirwe
discovery.desc: Irembo ryo kubona akazi gashya, imishinga n'ubufatanye mu bucuruzi.

trade.title: Guhuza ubucuruzi n'amasoko
trade.desc: Gukuraho icyuho kiri hagati y'abakora ibicuruzwa byo mu gihugu n'amasoko mpuzamahanga.

brandVideo.title: Nta kugaragara, nta <accent>terambere</accent>.
brandVideo.description: Muri Amamazanonaha, twizera ko buri bucuruzi bukwiye kubonwa. Urubuga rwacu rwubatswe kugira ngo ijwi ryawe rigere kure, kandi ruguhuze n'amahirwe wari utegereje.
brandVideo.growthDesc: Wagure ibikorwa byawe vuba, ugera ku bakiriya bakwiye ku gihe gikwiye.
brandVideo.discoveryDesc: Ubonwe n'abakiriya bashakisha neza ibyo utanga.
brandVideo.founderSub: Icyerekezo cy'iterambere rishingiye ku ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda

partners.title: Twizewe n'ibigo bikomeye ku isoko
partners.description: Twishimira ubufatanye dufitanye n'ubucuruzi buharanira ubuziranenge no guhanga udushya.

innovation.title: Guhanga udushya
innovation.desc: Twakira ibitekerezo bishya n'ibisubizo by'ikoranabuhanga byongera ireme ry'ubucuruzi n'iterambere.

trust.title: Icyizere
trust.desc: Kubaka urubuga rwizewe aho ubucuruzi n'abarukoresha bumva bafite umutekano.

professionalism.title: Ubunyamwuga
professionalism.desc: Gukora neza, kunyura mu mucyo no gutanga ubuziranenge muri byose.

accessibility.title: Kugerwaho na bose
accessibility.desc: Gutuma amahirwe aboneka, akagerwaho kandi agakoreshwa n'umuntu wese ku buryo bworoshye.

growth.title: Iterambere
growth.desc: Twiyemeje gufasha ubucuruzi kwagura aho bugera n'ubushobozi bwabwo.

partnership.title: Ubufatanye
partnership.desc: Duha agaciro umubano ukomeye, kugira ngo twubake intsinzi irambye hamwe.

howItWorks.title: Gukemura ibibazo binyuze mu guhuza abantu n'ikoranabuhanga
howItWorks.description: Abakiriya benshi bagorwa no kubona amahirwe yizewe ahantu hamwe, naho ubucuruzi bwinshi bukabura uko bumenyekana. Amamazanonaha Ltd ikemura ibyo byombi ishyiraho urubuga rumwe rw'ikoranabuhanga rutuma ubucuruzi bubonwa kandi bugahabwa amahirwe.

whyChoose.title: Kuki wahitamo Amamazanonaha?
whyChoose.description: Duhuriza hamwe ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, ubumenyi bwimbitse bw'iwacu n'urukundo rwo guteza imbere abaturage.

multiCategory.title: Ibyiciro byinshi ahantu hamwe
multiCategory.desc: Twita ku byo abantu batandukanye bakeneye, byose ku rubuga rumwe ruhuza.

digitalFirst.title: Ikoranabuhanga mbere na mbere
digitalFirst.desc: Rwubakiwe isoko rigezweho, aho kumenyekana no kugerwaho ari byo by'ingenzi.

localRelevance.title: Dukorera iwacu, twitegereza isi
localRelevance.desc: Twibanda ku Rwanda mu gihe twitegura amahirwe agera hanze y'imipaka.

growthSupport.title: Gufasha ubucuruzi gukura
growthSupport.desc: Tuvana ibirango mu kutamenyekana, tukabigeza aho bibonwa kandi bihanganira abandi ku isoko.

campaigns.title: Ibikorwa byacu bishya byo kwamamaza
campaigns.description: Dufasha ubucuruzi gukura tunyuze mu nkuru zishingiye kuri videwo kuri TikTok no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ibyo dukora bituma abantu bitabira kandi bikongera kumenyekana.

guide.title: Huza konti yawe ya TikTok
guide.desc: Kugira ngo ibyo ushyira kuri TikTok bigaragare ako kanya bitabangamiye umuvuduko w'urubuga, dukoresha Curator.io — igikoresho cy'ubuntu, gifite umutekano kandi gihuza n'ubunini bw'ibyuma bitandukanye.
guide.step1Desc: Jya kuri curator.io hanyuma wiyandikishe ku buntu.
guide.step2Desc: Hitamo TikTok nk'inkomoko, wemeze konti cyangwa ushakishe @amamazanonaha.ltd, hanyuma ushyireho urutonde rw'ibyo ushyira kuri TikTok.
guide.step3Title: Ongeraho Widget ID yawe muri environment variables
guide.step3Desc: Koporora umubare wihariye (hash) w'urutonde watangaje — usa n'urukurikirane rurerure rw'inyuguti n'imibare.
guide.tip: Inama: numara gushyira iyi ID muri dosiye ya .env, ongera utangize seriveri y'iterambere kugira ngo ubone ibiheruka gushyirwaho.

claudine.quote: Uru rubuga rwahinduye ubucuruzi bwanjye. Ngeza ibicuruzwa byanjye ku bakiriya ntari nzi ko babaho. Icuruzwa ryanjye ryikubye gatatu mu mezi atandatu gusa.

leonce.quote: Kwamamaza no kumenyekana byari imbogamizi yacu ikomeye. Amamazanonaha yaduhaye ikiraro twari dukeneye kugira ngo tugere ku bantu benshi.

jeanne.quote: Kubona serivisi nziza byajyaga bimara iminsi. Ubu mbona abanyamwuga bizewe mu minota mike. Icyizere n'ubunyamwuga ntibigereranywa.

faq.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
faq.description: Ibyo abantu batubaza kenshi ku rubuga rwacu, n'icyo rumarira abakiriya n'ubucuruzi.

problem.q: Ni ikihe kibazo Amamazanonaha Ltd ikemura?
problem.a: Dukemura ikibazo cyo kubura urubuga rumwe rwizewe ruhuriza hamwe amakuru y'ubucuruzi, ibicuruzwa na serivisi. Dufasha abakiriya kubona ibyo bakeneye byoroshye kandi byihuse, dufasha ibigo kongera kumenyekana no kubona amahirwe mashya y'ubucuruzi.

technology.q: Amamazanonaha Ltd ikoresha ite ikoranabuhanga mu gukemura ibyo bibazo?
technology.a: Twubatse urubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho ruhuza abantu, ibigo n'amasoko. Abakiriya bashobora gushakisha, kugereranya no guhitamo ibicuruzwa na serivisi bifitiwe icyizere batavuye aho bari.

customers.a: Abakiriya babona amakuru yizewe ahantu hamwe, bagahabwa amahitamo menshi, bakabasha kugereranya no gufata ibyemezo byiza, bityo bakazigama igihe n'amafaranga.

customerOpportunities.q: Ni ayahe mahirwe abakiriya babona bakoresheje Amamazanonaha Ltd?
customerOpportunities.a: Abakiriya babona amahirwe akomeye yo gutumiza ibicuruzwa n'ibikoresho bifuza biva mu Bushinwa no ku isi hose, mu buryo bworoshye, bwizewe kandi bwihuse bubafasha kuzigama igihe n'amafaranga.

businesses.q: Ni izihe nyungu ibigo n'ibirango by'ubucuruzi bibona?
businesses.a: Ibigo byongera kugaragara ku isoko, bikubaka icyizere, bikagera ku bakiriya benshi, kandi bikabona amahirwe mashya yo kugurisha no gukorana n'abafatanyabikorwa.

businessSupport.q: Amamazanonaha Ltd ifasha ite ibigo n'ibirango by'ubucuruzi?
businessSupport.a: Amamazanonaha Ltd ifasha ibigo n'ibirango by'ubucuruzi gukora imyirondoro yemejwe (Verified Business Profile) kandi y'umwuga, igaragaza neza ibicuruzwa na serivisi bitanga, aho bikorera, amakuru y'ingenzi ndetse n'indangagaciro zabyo.

verifiedProfile.q: Kuki gukora Verified Business Profile ari ingenzi?
verifiedProfile.a: Imyirondoro yemejwe ituma abakiriya bagira icyizere, bakamenya ko ikigo cyemewe kandi cyizewe. Ibi bifasha kongera icyizere, kugaragara ku isoko no kongera amahirwe yo kubona abakiriya bashya.

businessBenefits.q: Ni izihe nyungu ibigo bibona iyo bikoresheje urubuga rwa Amamazanonaha Ltd?

points.p1: Kugaragaza ibicuruzwa na serivisi ku buryo bw'umwuga.
points.p2: Kugerwaho n'abakiriya benshi mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo.
points.p3: Kubaka izina ryiza n'icyizere ku isoko.

contact.title: Twoherereze ubutumwa
contact.errorDesc: Hari ikitagenze neza. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa uduhamagare.

footer.description: Duteza imbere ubucuruzi bwifashisha ikoranabuhanga, dutuma bumenyekana kandi bugakura, byose ku rubuga rumwe rugezweho ruhuza u Rwanda na Afurika n'isi yose.
footer.newsletterDesc: Iyandikishe kugira ngo uhabwe amakuru mashya.

socialFeed.title: Kurikira urugendo rwacu
socialFeed.description: Komeza uhuze na Amamazanonaha kuri TikTok na Instagram, ubone ibigezweho n'ibikorwa byacu bya buri munsi.

meta.description: Duhuza abantu, ubucuruzi, ibicuruzwa n'amahirwe mu Rwanda no muri Afurika, byose ku rubuga rumwe rugezweho rw'ikoranabuhanga.
